floater.name: flycam_orbit
floater.title: Flycam Orbit

check_box.label: Enable Flycam Orbit
check_box.name: FlycamOrbitEnabled
check_box.tool_tip: While in flycam: orbit, pan and dolly relative to the anchor joint instead of free flight. Uncheck for normal flycam.

floater.text: Anchor: Cinematic Cam target + joint. Right-click an avatar > Cinematic Cam Follow, or use Target selected.

combo_box.name: CinematicCamJoint
combo_box.tool_tip: Skeleton joint to anchor the orbit on (type any joint name, including Bento bones)

check_box.label: Target selected avatar
check_box.name: CinematicCamUseSelected
check_box.tool_tip: Anchor on the selected avatar instead of yourself (falls back to you if nothing valid is selected)

check_box.label: Level horizon
check_box.name: FlycamOrbitLevel
check_box.tool_tip: Keep the orbit ring horizontal (ignore bone roll/pitch). Off = ride the full bone frame, GoPro-style

spinner.label: Min radius
spinner.name: FlycamOrbitMinRadius
spinner.tool_tip: Closest the dolly can approach the anchor (m)

spinner.label: Max radius
spinner.name: FlycamOrbitMaxRadius
spinner.tool_tip: Farthest the dolly can retreat from the anchor (m)

slider.label: Smoothing (s)
slider.name: FlycamOrbitSmoothing
slider.tool_tip: Temporal smoothing of the anchor motion only. 0 = rigid lock, higher = steadicam glide
